items.title: 구찌, '크리스마스의 여왕' 머라이어 캐리와 홀리데이 캠페인
items.summary: Gucci's 2026 holiday gift campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, is set in a hotel being dressed for Christmas and scored to her signature anthem. Carey wears the new Butterfly Special Collection (referencing her 1997 album) alongside the new Starlet handbag line in four silhouettes; items reach Gucci's Cheongdam flagship and other stores, with some pieces on Gucci.com.

items.title: グッチ ビューティの2026ホリデーが11月4日発売
items.summary: Gucci Beauty's 2026 holiday makeup and fragrance collection launches today, November 4, in Japan, themed around a 'Leonardo motif' with botanical green-and-gold packaging. The line includes cushion foundation, cheek-and-eye palettes, lip products and fragrance gift sets (Gucci Bloom, Guilty, Flora Gorgeous Gardenia), sold at Gucci Beauty counters and online while supplies last.

items.title: グッチ ビューティ、レオナルド モチーフの限定リップ・香水セットを発売
items.summary: Trade coverage of Gucci Beauty's 2026 Christmas coffret collection, confirming the Renaissance-textile-inspired 'Leonardo motif' design direction, product lineup and November 4 on-sale date at Gucci Beauty counters nationwide and via e-commerce.

items.title: 잘 나가던 명품 '주춤'…가격 인상 피로감에 소비 열기 식나
items.summary: Korean department-store luxury sales growth decelerated sharply from roughly 40% in Q2 to 10-15% in October at Lotte, Shinsegae and Hyundai, which the piece attributes to cumulative price-increase fatigue and a shrinking wealth effect from weaker equity markets. The article explicitly notes Gucci's own Q3 revenue fell 6% year on year, and that jewelry category growth cratered from 65-80% to 15-20%.

items.title: 롯데·신세계·현대 명품 매출 신장률, 2분기 40%대서 10월 10%대로 급락
items.summary: Confirms the same department-store luxury growth collapse (Lotte 40%->15%, Shinsegae 40.9%->10.2%, Hyundai 41.4%->11.8%) and adds that Kering's share price fell 16% in a single day on October 23 and is down roughly 40% year-to-date, tying consumer fatigue with price hikes directly to Kering/Gucci's deteriorating equity story.

items.title: Gucci打破传统推「中国制造」运动鞋 业内人士：恐削弱品牌形象
items.summary: Reports Gucci's 'Drip' sneaker, the first Demna-era shoe to carry a 'Made in China' label, breaking decades of Italian-manufacturing positioning; priced around 800 euro / US$1,000. A Berenberg analyst is quoted warning the production origin may clash with the luxury repositioning Gucci is trying to execute amid falling sales; Gucci maintains Italy stays core to its identity.

items.title: Gucci首次认"中国制造"！7000元运动鞋引热议
items.summary: Chinese coverage of the same Drip and slip-on sneaker Made-in-China launch (7,050 yuan / 6,380 yuan), noting it lands during Gucci's 12th consecutive quarter of sales decline (Q2 2026 down 4% YoY) and citing an industry analyst downplaying the stigma as normal global-supply-chain practice; frames the pricing as essentially unchanged versus the prior all-Italy production.

items.title: 官方包袋降价超40%撞上中国产球鞋7050元一分没降：蹲Gucci的观望党全解析
items.summary: Chinese deal/shopping-community post dissecting the contradiction between Gucci's >40% official bag price cuts in some lines versus the unchanged 7,050 yuan price on the new China-made sneaker; advises bargain-hunting readers to check tag price, country of origin and resale value before buying, reflecting wait-and-see consumer sentiment rather than enthusiasm.

items.title: 古驰国内外价差有多大？以Drip运动鞋为例拆解真相
items.summary: Weibo FAQ-style consumer post using the Drip sneaker as a case study of Gucci's China-vs-overseas price gap, concluding the China-made shoe is priced roughly on par with (not cheaper than) the US/EU tags despite local manufacturing, a point several commenters cite as evidence Gucci is not passing on cost savings to Chinese buyers.

items.title: 古驰保值吗？2026年真实回收数据：最高72%的只有这3款
items.summary: Resale-market data post reporting that the 1955 Horsebit small bag retains the highest resale value in the Gucci range (58-72% of retail at 95%-condition resale), while the GG Marmont bucket and Dionysus medium hold only 40-60%, offered as practical guidance for secondhand buyers/sellers amid broader luxury resale softness.

items.title: 구찌 308 루시 다크 오렌지 겨우 구해봤어
items.summary: Korean women's community (theqoo) beauty-board post from a user who struggled to find Gucci lipstick shade 308 'Lucy Dark Orange' in stock across department-store counters, sparking replies comparing availability and swatches; low-key but genuine organic product buzz rather than brand-seeded content.

items.title: 천원짜리 숏드라마 같다는 중국 구찌 칠석 캠페인
items.summary: Korean community thread mocking a Gucci China Qixi (Chinese Valentine's) campaign short film as resembling a cheap micro-drama production, with commenters criticizing the creative quality as beneath a luxury house; representative of mild derision rather than outrage toward Gucci's China marketing output.

items.title: 高級ブランド、中国復調が業績下支え エルメスは10〜12月に3%増収
items.summary: Nikkei reporting that while Hermes posted Q4 China-driven revenue growth (+3%) on strong leather-goods (Birkin/Kelly, +10.8%), peers including Kering/Gucci and LVMH continue to see Chinese demand merely 'flat to slightly improving' rather than recovering, underscoring Gucci's comparative underperformance versus hard-luxury leaders in the region.

items.title: Gucci is facing backlash for trying to get cheap with production costs, but the price tag isn't changing
items.summary: English-language aggregation of social-media backlash to the Gucci Drip sneaker's Made-in-China label, framing the core consumer complaint as paying the same (or higher) luxury price for production many associate with lower manufacturing cost, and noting analyst warnings that the move creates tension between provenance and luxury positioning.
